name: set_event_effect_rotation

stack.evidence: ScriptCommand_SetEventEffectRotation consumes an event-effect ID and three angles, resolves the ID through func_001775E8, converts each angle from degrees to the PPP fixed-turn representation, and writes the three components through the entry's rotation pointer

notes: func_001775E8 resolves IDs in the D_0035C010 event-effect manager. All three JP calls are copies of the same tw09.ard call (0, 0, var16[0xD54], 0), changing only the Y rotation of event effect 0.
